entries.feature: Closed canonical grammar [primary+][shift+][alt+]<key> (key: a-z, 0-9, return, escape, tab, space, delete, up, down, left, right, home, end, page_up, page_down, f1-f12), at most 32 bytes checked before parsing, every key except f1-f12 requires primary; non-string, empty, over-length, unknown token (including upper case), duplicate or misordered modifier, modifier-only and bare keys fail explicitly with identical reasons in Rust and Swift on every decode path (node records, SET_PROPERTY, BATCH_PROPERTY_SET, event arguments, model items, small records) and again at apply (invalid_shortcut); malformed wire vectors for over-length, unknown token and duplicate modifier
